title: Styles in stone: the world's architectural styles on a map, century by century
excerpt: 180,451 buildings with an architectural style in Wikidata, sorted into 25 families and mapped through time. Romanesque gives way to Gothic, Baroque and the revivals, Gothic Revival sails to Toronto and Melbourne, and the gaps show who keeps the records.
seo_description: A world map of architectural styles through time: 180,451 buildings from Wikidata, from Romanesque and Gothic to Art Deco and Brutalist.
header_alt: Title card reading 'Styles in stone' in black and slate blue on pale stone, beside a world map dotted with 180,451 buildings coloured by architectural style, dense across Europe and the eastern United States, with Persian blue in Iran and Japanese purple in Japan.
